cases.task: Review the queue protocol update and identify necessary follow-up work in the repository.

contracts.before: The shared queue policy expresses leaseDuration in milliseconds; acquiredAt and other timestamps are milliseconds.
contracts.after: The shared queue policy expresses leaseDuration in seconds; acquiredAt and other timestamps remain milliseconds.

evidence.quote: export const leaseExpiresAt = (acquiredAt, policy) => acquiredAt + policy.leaseDuration;
export const leaseExpiresAt = (acquiredAt, policy) => acquiredAt + policy.leaseDuration * 1000;

contracts.before: An idempotency key identifies one logical job across all queues.
contracts.after: An idempotency key identifies a logical job only within its queue.

JSON responses declare application/json. Text exports declare their encoding explicitly.
afterFiles.docs/reference/pagination.md:
# Pagination links
A response includes a continuation cursor when more results are available. Clients preserve selected filters when following it.
afterFiles.docs/reference/error-shape.md:
# Error payloads
Errors contain a stable code and a user-facing message. Debug details remain in local diagnostics.
afterFiles.docs/reference/sort-order.md:
# List ordering
Sort selection is explicit. Records with equal sort values use their stable record identifier as the final tie breaker.
afterFiles.docs/reference/uploads.md:
# Upload completion
Files become visible only after completion is acknowledged. An interrupted upload does not create a completed attachment.
afterFiles.docs/reference/translations.md:
# Translation files
Translation keys remain stable when wording changes. Missing localized strings fall back to the default language.
afterFiles.docs/reference/help-links.md:
# Context help
Help links preserve their section anchor. External help opens in a separate browsing context.
afterFiles.docs/reference/empty-states.md:
# Empty states
A filtered list explains when no entries match. A first-use empty state links to the action that creates an entry.

import { productKey } from './product-key.mjs';
export const sameCatalogName = (left, right) => productKey(left) === productKey(right);
afterFiles.docs/de/Prüfung.md:
# Prüfung von Produktnamen
Die Importprüfung verwendet dieselbe Namensidentität wie der Katalog.

Die Schreibweisen „Café“ und „Café“
gelten trotz gleicher Darstellung als unterschiedliche Produktnamen.
Die Groß- und Kleinschreibung wird ignoriert.
afterFiles.docs/catalog.md:
# Catalog names
Names are normalized to Unicode NFC and then compared without regard to letter case. Canonically equivalent sequences identify the same name.
